label: Media Grid
description: 2-6 screenshots or clips as one composed spread: 2-up, hero + 2, 2x2, 3x2 (auto by count; a tall frame stacks). Rounded tiles with a hairline, a slow push inside each frame, a caption chip per tile; tiles land one after another; highlight dims the rest and rings the one that matters. For 'here's all of it at once' proof beats.

items.label: Tiles: {src (image or .mp4/.webm clip), caption, position (object-position, e.g. 'center top'), video, start_at}

layout.label: auto (default: 2-up, hero+2, 2x2, 3x2 by count) | row (all in one row)

highlight.label: Index of the tile to ring (others dim)

push.label: Slow push inside each tile (default true)

theme.label: Ink theme; omit to follow the measured scene ground

at.label: Seconds into the scene it enters (default 0.2)
